title: Evaluation of a binary tree conversion
statement: Let $T$ be a binary decision tree on $n$ coordinates with labels in a type $\alpha$, and let $x$ assign an element of $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ to each coordinate. Evaluating the finite-alphabet decision tree over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ obtained from $T$ gives the same label as evaluating $T$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A binary decision tree on n coordinates with labels in α and its indexed available-coordinate set
An input x : Fin n → ZMod 2
